answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents anchor identity in cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs. New agents stake escalating collateral: the cost scales exponentially as O(2^n) per swarm node, pushing malicious actors off an economic ledge. Trust seeds root in a verified grove of initial attestors, while honest actors harvest staking yield across the open meadow, ensuring exponential capital exhaustion for Sybil swarms.
